Services

Waterline up.

From regular washes to full restoration, priced and planned around your boat.

01

Wash Programs

Weekly, bi-weekly and monthly washdowns to keep your boat clean.

02

3-Step Full-Service Detail

A full wash plus mold, rust and metal work, then compound, polish and wax.

03

Oxidation Removal

Faded, chalky surfaces restored to a deep, glossy shine.

04

Gelcoat Restoration

Dull, faded gelcoat revived and protected from further damage.

05

Teak Treatment

Sanding, sealing and oiling to restore and renew your teak.

06

Paint refinishing and new paint, with Pettit and Hempel products.
